description: The plot illustrates the validation performance of two models—XMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, as measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric, which decreases as model performance improves. The x-axis represents “Training Steps,” scaled in thousands (×10³), ranging from 0 to 50,000 steps with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis shows BPC values on a linear scale from approximately 1.1 to 2.1, with gridlines at 0.25 intervals. The yellow line with triangle markers, labeled “XMoE Validating,” begins at roughly 2.05 BPC at 0 steps, drops sharply to about 1.3 BPC by 10,000 steps, and then gradually declines to stabilize near 1.15 BPC by 50,000 steps. The magenta line with circle markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” starts slightly higher at approximately 2.1 BPC, also drops steeply to around 1.3 BPC by 10,000 steps, and continues to decline more gradually, reaching approximately 1.12 BPC by 50,000 steps. Both lines exhibit a steep initial decline followed by a slower convergence, with SimSMoE consistently achieving a slightly lower (better) BPC than XMoE after about 15,000 steps.
